items.title: Marshall Lawrence Interview, 1960-06-28
items.q: I don't remember him playing, but I knew him.

ctx.x: I don't know. And his brother played the E flat in the honors band. His brother was Albert Trish. Albert Trish. That was in the honors band. I don't remember him playing, but I knew him.
And who was Murray Cole? What did he play?
